entry.title: Peter Finch Golf: My Lesson With THE WORLD'S No1 PUTTING COACH | Phil Kenyon
entry.summary: Phil Kenyon, the world-renowned putting coach behind champions like Rory McIlroy and Scottie Scheffler, hooks up with Peter Finch for an in-depth putting masterclass. They cover green reading, putter setup, stroke path, tempo and distance control—plus mindset drills and pro tips you can use right away to start sinking more putts. Along the way you’ll find links to Phil’s website, a deep dive on strokes-gained stats and Finch’s gear page (with discount codes!). Whether you’re a total newbie or a low-handicap player, this session is a tour-level shortcut to lower scores on the greens.

entry.title: Noclip: The Story Behind Battlefield 3's Divisive Campaign - Noclip
entry.summary: Noclip’s latest documentary features Danny O’Dwyer sitting down with Battlefield 3’s single-player lead designer David Goldfarb to unpack what made the campaign so divisive. They dive into each signature mission—from the jet-fueled “Going Hunting” and tank-heavy “Thunder Run” to the moody “Night Shift,” the intro level “Swordbreaker,” and the gritty Paris set-piece “Comrades.” Along the way they chat about how Frostbite 2 shaped the game’s look and feel, the role of quick-time events, and what it was like remembering development years later. (Oh, and if you want to support more free game docs, yup—you know where the Patreon link is.)
